findings.finding: The Europe IX final close (EUR12bn, 9 Sep 2026; EUR11bn at 30 Jun) adds about EUR1bn, roughly $1.13bn, to Q2 fundraising. On top of Q1's $4.1bn that already locks in about $5.23bn, the consensus LOW for H1 ($5.22bn), so the consensus average of $5.96bn needs only about $0.7bn from every other strategy in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Fundraising-led Q1 FY27 statement (+$4.1bn, Europe IX ahead of target) moved +5.53% on 2026-07-15; H1 FY26 interims with the Amundi deal +4.45% on 2025-11-18 (baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the close was public on 9 Sep and the consensus is company-published, so analysts sat above the Q1-plus-Europe-IX sum knowingly. What is not public is the roughly $0.7bn of other Q2 flows. If the market expected a shortfall, the shares would not have rebounded 12% from the October low with flat short interest.

findings.finding: Fundraising since 1 Apr 2024 stands at about $44bn after Q1 FY27 ($40bn by FY26 plus $4.1bn) and about $46bn with Q2 at consensus, against the at-least-$55bn FY25-FY28 target the company said it may hit 'potentially a year early'. That makes a reset of the medium-term target at these interims possible, though not signalled.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guidance update on performance-fee recognition (Oct 2025) and the FY26 guidance re-presentation (21 May 2026, +2.89%) moved the shares modestly; no precedent for a fundraising-target reset in the baseline history.
findings.why_not_priced: The company itself said the target may be met a year early, and consensus FY27-FY28 fundraising ($11.5bn + $18.7bn) already sits far above it, so the arithmetic is priced. Only a formal new target would be news, and it is more likely at full-year results or a capital-markets day than at an interim. Hence small.

findings.finding: The last two interim dividends were one-third of the prior year's total (26.3p of 79p for FY25, 27.7p of 83p for FY26), which points to a 29.0p FY27 interim on the 87p FY26 total. That equals the consensus high; the 25p consensus average is pulled down by a 0p entry.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Dividend has risen 16 consecutive years; no reaction in the baseline attributable to the dividend line.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the pattern is mechanical and every holder can compute it. It matters only in that a 29p interim reads as a 'beat' against the distorted average. Sized near zero.
